summary: Calibre-Web is a self-hosted Python/Flask web app for browsing, reading, downloading and editing a Calibre ebook library (SQLite). It maintains its own app DB (user, shelf, read-state, downloads, settings, auth tokens, thumbnails) plus reads/writes the Calibre library DB (books, authors, tags, series, ratings, languages, publishers, data formats, identifiers, comments, metadata_dirtied, custom columns). Operations create/update/delete users, shelves, reading state, bookmarks, archived books, downloads and config, and edit/upload/delete/convert/merge library books.
